description:
Upload your photos and videos, and Glinded turns them into a finished memorial video with music, transitions, and text overlays. Just describe what you want — no editing skills needed.

Every video comes with licensed music your funeral home can actually play. Choose from thousands of professional tracks or our Creative Commons catalog.

Works for funeral slideshows, celebration of life videos, remembrance videos, and honoring beloved pets.
